coverageNotes: IMPORTANT LIMITATION: this round did NOT achieve search-based discovery. The shared WebSearch budget for the turn (200 calls, shared by every agent) was already exhausted when this group started, so all six search attempts (gym in Karen Nairobi; gym in Ongata Rongai; gym in Ngong town Kajiado; gym in Kitengela membership; gym Syokimau Mombasa Road fitness centre; gym Athi River Kenya fitness) returned 'web search not performed'. The queries array is therefore empty on purpose. I did not use curl, third-party readers, archives or directory crawling to get around the limit, and I did not add any venue from memory. What was done: (1) read the 76 seed venues in Karen/Langata/Rongai/Ngong/Kiserian/Kitengela/Athi River/Syokimau/Mlolongo and the Kajiado and Machakos county entries; (2) opened the seed venues' own websites with WebFetch to look for new facts. Result: 2 seed venues have new evidenced facts (Ongata Rongai Boxing Club: street location, hours, email; Dojo Wellness Club, Karen: street address, opening hours, social pointers). 0 new venues (newCount=0). Seed-data quality flags from the fetches, not candidates: the seed website http://www.nextlevelfitness.co.ke/ (NextLevel Fitness Syokimau / Next Level Fitness Gym and Spa) loads only a 'We're Coming Soon' placeholder whose social links point to an unrelated brand (OLITT), so that seed website looks wrong or stale; kehlfitness.com (Kehl Fitness Gym, Kitengela), outdoorfitness.co.ke (Outdoor Fitness) and kravmagakenya.com (Sacura Martial Arts Academy) do not resolve in DNS (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND), which suggests dead domains but is not proof the venues are closed; firstpowerfitness.com (FirstPower CrossFit), tongilmoodo.com (Sasamoto Tong-Il Moo-Do) returned HTTP 503 and thfcsite.onlinepfm.net (Thabiti Health and Fitness Center) returned HTTP 500 on repeated tries, so they could not be assessed. The seed's feelfitnesscenter.org entry is Feel Fitness Center at Muthaiga North Road, Exit 7 off Thika Highway (page footer 2021), which is outside this region group despite the Rongai-area coordinates attached to it. Areas with NO new research this round: Karen (other than Dojo), Ngong, Kiserian, Kitengela, Athi River, Syokimau, Mlolongo, Ongata Rongai (other than ORBC), including hotel, club, university, yoga, pilates and CrossFit searches. No county has been shown to lack online presence; the gap is search access, not evidence of absence. This group should be re-run once the web-search budget is available (suggested: raise CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION or run in a follow-up turn). Evidence quotes are as returned by the WebFetch page-reading tool (a small model summarising the fetched page), not raw HTML.
